changes.summary: Declared separate document and optional OCR-config slots and the exact application/zip output contract.
Made the adapter consume the controller-authenticated slot manifest before model loading.
Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Add the executable Pending HunyuanOCR 1.5 DFlash document-image job for one DGX Spark.
changes.details: Pins Tencent's target and DFlash draft, uses the official 12 task prompts and fixed sampling, preserves repetition cleanup and document Markdown normalization, and emits a ZIP with UTF-8 results plus provenance metadata.
